goal: Rust-own the current-C single selected fd upload attempt boundary: after an attempted fd upload fails, continue to registration or device-copy fallback without a second buffered fd upload.

semantics: current C calls cuda_model_range_ptr_from_fd once per unresolved range and accepts a non-null result before later fallback handling
staging, read, asynchronous copy, event, and final upload synchronization failures return NULL from that one fd attempt
after NULL, current C continues into range registration and device-copy fallback rather than launching a second fd upload

implementation.selection_path: with_cached_abi_model_range now selects either the direct-I/O fd path or the buffered-only fd path once, so failure of a selected direct path continues to registration/device copy without retrying through buffered fd caching
implementation.live_boundary: the linked consumer selects the direct fd branch by environment, interposes one cuMemcpyHtoDAsync_v2 failure after tensor setup, rejects registration, and distinguishes correct host-byte device-copy fallback from an incorrect second fd upload using divergent fd bytes
implementation.remaining_policy_boundary: the routing fix applies after any selected fd upload returns failure, but live failure injection separately observes asynchronous copy only; staged allocation, read, event, final-sync, q8/f16, graph-compute, and route-promotion boundaries remain pending

integration_risks: the live linked consumer forces the selected fd upload asynchronous-copy failure through cuda-oxide driver symbol cuMemcpyHtoDAsync_v2 and verifies the subsequent host-byte device-copy fallback
staged allocation, fd read, event-record, event-wait, and final stream-synchronization failure routes share the corrected one-attempt source path but are not separately forced live by this consumer
q8/f16 hooks, production linker selection, remaining graph compute exports, and C CUDA removal remain pending
